s: Who was the founder of Kisan Movement in Andhra?
x:
Acharya N. G. Ranga is regarded as the founder of the Kisan (Peasant) Movement in Andhra Pradesh. A distinguished freedom fighter, parliamentarian and agricultural economist, he devoted his life to protecting the interests of farmers. He organized peasants against excessive land revenue, exploitation by landlords and unjust colonial policies. Through the Ryot Associations and later the Kisan Movement, he mobilized farmers across Andhra and brought their grievances into the national political arena. N. G. Ranga also played a leading role in the All India Kisan Sabha and became one of India's foremost champions of farmers' rights. His contributions earned him the title "Acharya", reflecting his role as a teacher and guide to the peasantry.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (4).
n: Founder of Andhra Kisan Movement – Acharya N. G. Ranga
Known as – Champion of Indian Farmers
Associated with – All India Kisan Sabha

s: Who was the member from Andhra who joined the Forward Bloc formed by Subhas Chandra Bose?
x:
Madduri Annapurnaiah was a prominent freedom fighter and socialist leader from Andhra who joined the Forward Bloc, founded by Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose in 1939 after his resignation from the Indian National Congress presidency. The Forward Bloc sought to unite all left-wing and anti-imperialist forces to intensify the struggle for India's independence. Madduri Annapurnaiah supported the nationalist and socialist ideals of Subhas Chandra Bose and actively associated himself with the movement. His contribution occupies an important place in the political history of Andhra during the freedom struggle.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (1).
n: Andhra leader in Forward Bloc – Madduri Annapurnaiah
